race.description: Community Of Adelong Country Boosted (Bm58) Hcp
race.comment: RACY THOUGHTS (9) led for the judge but was easily accounted for at the end of a BM58 over 1300m at Corowa last start. Fitter for two runs back from a spell and coming back a little in distance looks a winning move. BOLD CONQUER (6) has a win and two placings from just three career runs. Went close over 1200m at Nowra last time and from gate one is sure to enjoy every favour in the run. JUSTBETRYIN' (3) disappointed at Cootamundra last start but drops in class today and can do a lot better. IROQUAI (15) comes right into calculations following a few key scratchings.
